The statement adds the gloss "backlog row" for inc-062 and "Before this ruling"; both follow from the framing line's tense and from inc-NNN being this programme's row ids, so the claim does not overreach.

"Keep County." is line 7 of the file, the whole of the verbatim ruling blockquote. Read with the framing line on line 5, which names the address book's add-details step, the statement (the step keeps its County field, it is not removed) is exactly what those three words decide. This is the one true verbatim decision in the source.

The label also matches the role recorded for this source in sources.json, so the inference is sound and disclosed.
